name: Ohio Grade 7 · Plane sections of solids

questions.text: A right rectangular prism has base 5 by 11 and height 5. A plane cuts parallel to the base. What is the section?
questions.explanation: A plane section is a flat shape determined by the solid and the direction of the cut.
questions.subject: Grade 7 · Geometry

questions.text: A square pyramid has base side 5 and height 6. A vertical plane through its apex and the center of the base cuts it. What shape is the section?
questions.explanation: A plane section is a flat shape determined by the solid and the direction of the cut.
